question: What Are AI, AO, DI and DO Signals in a PLC?
body_html:
AI, AO, DI and DO are the four basic I/O signal types: inputs carry information from field devices to the controller, and outputs carry commands from the controller to the field.

SignalTypical formExample
AI (Analog Input)4 to 20 mA, 0 to 10 V, RTDPressure or temperature transmitter
AO (Analog Output)4 to 20 mAControl valve positioner, VFD speed reference
DI (Digital Input)24 V DC ON/OFFLimit switch, push button, level switch
DO (Digital Output)24 V DC or relayMotor starter, solenoid valve, alarm lamp
